why: output_dir is double-guarded: GenerateUMLInput.validate_output_location (mcp_core/tools/schemas.py) rejects it in read-only/memory-only mode and otherwise requires it resolve under MCP_OUTPUT_ROOT unless MCP_ALLOW_ARBITRARY_OUTPUT_DIR=true, and generate_diagram()._sanitize_output_dir (mcp_core/core/utils.py) re-checks the same sandbox independently; the written filename is server-generated (diagram_type_timestamp) not caller-controlled, and diagram_type is restricted to an admin-configured allow-list so no arbitrary remote host is reachable.

Delegates each item to the same GenerateUMLInput/generate_from_request path as generate_uml (mcp_core/tools/diagram_tools.py _render_batch_item), so the same output_dir sandbox and diagram_type allow-list apply; batch size is bounded by MCP_SETTINGS.batch_max_items and worker concurrency is clamped 1-16, so no unbounded resource sink either.

output_dir is hardcoded to None in this tool (mcp_core/tools/diagram_tools.py generate_uml_image), so there is no file-write sink; the only network fetch targets are the admin-configured kroki_server/plantuml_server/mermaid.ink endpoints, not anything derived from caller input.
Purely filters an in-memory dict of admin-defined diagram type metadata by substring/equality match; no file, network, or process sink is reachable from query/backend/output_format/limit.

validate_uml_inputs (mcp_core/core/diagram_validation.py) only does local string/regex structural checks on the code argument and never renders, executes, or makes a network call, so there is no sink for the caller-controlled code/diagram_type/output_format.

query (zod length-bounded string) is forwarded as a JSON body field to POST {baseUrl}/api/rag/query with the caller's own Bearer API key (src/handlers/static-handlers.ts handleAskKnowledgeBase); the sink is the caller's own Plugged.in account/RAG index, not a shared or filesystem resource.

ClipboardDeleteInputSchema-validated args are sent as the DELETE body to {baseUrl}/api/clipboard (handleClipboardDelete); it only ever deletes the caller's own clipboard entries via their own API key.
name/idx/contentType/limit/offset are URL-encoded via URLSearchParams into a GET to {baseUrl}/api/clipboard (handleClipboardGet); read-only access to the caller's own clipboard entries only.
contentType/limit/offset are URL-encoded via URLSearchParams into a GET to {baseUrl}/api/clipboard (handleClipboardList); no injection surface and the sink is the caller's own account data.
Takes no meaningful input (schema parse only) and POSTs an empty body to {baseUrl}/api/clipboard/pop (handleClipboardPop); no caller-controlled data reaches any sink.

ClipboardPushInputSchema-validated body (value/contentType/encoding/visibility, contentType regex-checked as MIME_TYPE_REGEX) is POSTed as JSON to {baseUrl}/api/clipboard/push (handleClipboardPush); writes only to the caller's own clipboard.

ClipboardSetInputSchema-validated body is POSTed as JSON to {baseUrl}/api/clipboard (handleClipboardSet); name is length-bounded, contentType is MIME-regex checked, and the sink is the caller's own clipboard store.
CreateDocumentInputSchema-validated args are POSTed as JSON to {baseUrl}/api/documents/ai (handleCreateDocument) with the caller's Bearer key; creates a document only in the caller's own library.

sink: spliced unencoded into a REST URL path segment used for an authenticated axios.delete request to the backend
why: DeleteNotificationInputSchema (src/schemas/index.ts:48-51) only enforces z.string().min(1) with no path-safe format, unlike the UUID- or regex-restricted id params used elsewhere in the same file (documentId, session_uuid, memory_session_id); a notificationId containing '/', '..', '?', or '#' changes the actual path/target of the DELETE request. Impact is bounded by the caller's own credentials and I cannot confirm from this repo alone (the backend router isn't in this checkout) whether traversal actually reaches a different endpoint, so this is Tier B, not A.
contract: Delete a notification from the Plugged.in system

why: server_uuid (zod uuid, optional) and force_refresh (boolean) are only used to call getMcpServers() against the caller's own configured Plugged.in servers (handleDiscoverTools); no caller-controlled string reaches a local sink.

documentId is validated as z.string().uuid() (GetDocumentInputSchema) before being placed in the URL path to GET {baseUrl}/api/documents/{documentId} (handleGetDocument), so no path/query injection is possible; the sink is the caller's own document library.
All filter fields are appended via URLSearchParams (auto percent-encoded) into a GET to {baseUrl}/api/documents (handleListDocuments); read-only access to the caller's own document list.

onlyUnread/limit/severity are appended via URLSearchParams into a GET to {baseUrl}/api/notifications (handleListNotifications); no path injection surface and the sink is the caller's own notifications.

sink: spliced unencoded into a REST URL path segment used for an authenticated axios.patch request to the backend
why: Same root cause as pluggedin_delete_notification: MarkNotificationDoneInputSchema (src/schemas/index.ts:42-45) only enforces z.string().min(1), no path-safe format, then the raw string is spliced unencoded into the PATCH URL. A value containing '/', '..', '?' or '#' would change the request path actually sent. Cannot confirm real traversal impact without the backend router (not in this repo), so Tier B.
contract: Mark a notification as done in the Plugged.in system

why: memory_uuids array is passed as a JSON POST body field to {baseUrl}/api/memory/search/details (handleMemoryDetails); no path interpolation, and the sink is the caller's own memory store.

session_uuid is validated as z.string().uuid() (MemoryObserveInputSchema) before being placed in the URL path to POST {baseUrl}/api/memory/sessions/{session_uuid}/observations (handleMemoryObserve); type is a fixed enum, content is length-capped; no injection surface.
query is sent as a JSON POST body field to {baseUrl}/api/memory/search (handleMemorySearch); no path interpolation, sink is the caller's own memory index.

memory_session_id is validated with regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ (MemorySessionEndInputSchema, src/schemas/index.ts:362-365) before being placed in the URL path to PATCH {baseUrl}/api/memory/sessions/{memory_session_id} (handleMemorySessionEnd), so no '/', '..' or query-breaking characters can reach the path.
Schema-validated args are POSTed as a JSON body to {baseUrl}/api/memory/sessions (handleMemorySessionStart); no caller-controlled path interpolation.
query and filters are sent as a JSON POST body to {baseUrl}/api/documents/search (handleSearchDocuments); no path interpolation, sink is the caller's own document library.

title/message/severity/sendEmail are sent as a JSON POST body to {baseUrl}/api/notifications (handleSendNotification) using the caller's own API key; delivers only to the caller's own account/notification/email channel.

handleSetup switches on args.topic across a fixed, hardcoded set of case labels ('getting_started','api_key','configuration','troubleshooting') and returns only static help text for each; no caller-controlled string is echoed, interpreted, or reaches any sink.

documentId is validated as z.string().uuid() (UpdateDocumentInputSchema) before being placed in the URL path to PATCH {baseUrl}/api/documents/{documentId} (handleUpdateDocument); operation is a fixed enum; content/metadata are JSON body fields; sink is the caller's own document.
